title: List_of_Static_Encounters
lead_summary: Static Encounters are Pokémon interactable in the overworld instead of as wild encounters. In most cases, if the player leaves the encounter (by capturing, defeating, or running away), the static encounters will not respawn (unless specified otherwise).
raw_wikitext:
Static Encounters are Pokémon interactable in the overworld instead of as wild encounters. Expand

Random chance (based on step count) when interacting with a flower

Collapse

The game keeps track of the total steps taken. If the player interacts with a flower when the steps are divisible by 25, the player will receive the Fairy Flower hat or encounter a Fomantis with 50% chance of each. If the player already has the Fairy Flower hat then the Fomantis encounter is guaranteed. Afterwards the total steps counter will increase by 1 so the encounter can't be instantly repeated.
